achievements.displayName: A Tale of Origins and Endings

steps.text: Earn the 45 other base-game achievements; DLC achievements are not required for this one.
Complete the main mission "Illusion at Journey's End".
Complete the main mission "The Journey Begins".

achievements.displayName: The King of the Dark Elves

steps.text: Complete the main mission "Audience with the Dark Elf".
Complete the main mission "Natural Distortion".
Complete the main mission "A Familiar Place".
Complete the main mission "Memories of Wind".
Complete the main mission "Memories of Poison".
Complete the main mission "Memories of Fire".
Complete the main mission "Phantoms of the Past".
Complete the main mission "Memories of Earth".
Complete the main mission "To Remember".
Complete the main mission "Memories of Water".
Complete the main mission "Schemes of the Past".
Complete the main mission "Remembering Home".
Complete the main mission "The Suffering of Fools".
Complete the final main mission "A Fraught Journey"; Story (Casual) difficulty is fine.

achievements.summary: Finish the main story on any difficulty.

steps.text: After finishing the story, set CHAOS difficulty and complete "Illusion at Journey's End". The achievement unlocks here even though its description says to clear the game on CHAOS; this is a known bug.

achievements.summary: Clear a CHAOS mission; the achievement unlocks early.

steps.text: Raise a mission's level to 200 or higher on CHAOS difficulty and complete it; revisit it with better gear as needed.

achievements.summary: Complete a level 200 or higher mission on CHAOS.

steps.text: From the world map, select any unlocked side mission and complete it.
Complete every side mission; most unlock automatically as you finish main story missions.
The seven hidden side missions need Memory Mementos: pick one up in its main mission and the side mission unlocks immediately, even if you leave the mission.
Memento 1 (Scarlet Memories: The Shackled): in Natural Distortion, after the first Dark Vent turn right to the hidden ledge and follow the cave to the end.
Memento 2 (Scarlet Memories: The Savior): in A Familiar Place, from the Hall of the Brave stairs drop down the right side repeatedly.
Memento 3 (Indigo Memories: The Humiliated): in Memories of Poison, drop down the hole in the Cave of Dying Light, defeat the flower, then break the wall.
Memento 4 (Indigo Memories: The Deceived): in Memories of Fire, at Path of Destiny pass the boulder and chest, then drop down to the left.
Memento 5 (Azure Memories: The Stymied): in Memories of Earth, drop through the moving-wall rooms from the Aspirant's Hallway and break the left wall.
Memento 6 (Coral Memories: The Greedy): in To Remember, near the end it sits behind the large rock by the cannon bridge.
Memento 7 (Indigo Memories: The Stabbed): in The Suffering of Fools, cross the left Path of the Forlorn bridge and drop down the hole with bones.
Complete all 24 side missions; the achievement unlocks when the last one is cleared.

achievements.description: Used soul burst for the first time.

steps.text: Use Soul Burst on an enemy during a mission.

achievements.summary: Use Soul Burst for the first time.

achievements.description: Used a weapon ability for the first time.

steps.text: Use any weapon ability in combat.

achievements.summary: Use a weapon ability for the first time.

steps.text: Defeat any cactuar; they appear across many missions and are also targets of some side missions.
Defeat any tonberry; they appear across many missions and are also targets of some side missions.
Approach a savepoint cube in any mission; anima shards are awarded automatically.
In post-story or CHAOS missions, approach savepoint cubes until an anima crystal is awarded.
Pick up any artifact, an equipment item with two job affinities; they drop in CHAOS missions and post-story content.
Complete the side mission Indigo Memories: The Stabbed to earn Smith's Hammer III, then use a job crest on a piece of equipment at the Smith to raise its affinity.

achievements.summary: Use a job crest at the smithy.

achievements.description: Fully upgraded the special effect of a piece of equipment.

steps.text: At the Smith on the world map, fully upgrade one piece of equipment's special effect.

achievements.summary: Fully upgrade an equipment special effect.

achievements.description: Unlocked every job affinity bonus for a single job.

steps.text: Raise one job's affinity to 400%; artifacts and auto-equip make this easy in the endgame.

achievements.summary: Unlock every affinity bonus for one job.

achievements.description: Unlocked every panel in the job tree for a single job.

steps.text: Level one job to 30 and spend job points until every panel in its tree is unlocked.

achievements.summary: Unlock every panel in one job tree.

steps.text: Unlock a limit release on a job, level it past 30, then spend a master point from its job tree.
Earn three limit releases for one job on CHAOS missions, level it to 99, and reach MASTER rank 4.

achievements.summary: Reach MASTER rank 4 on one job.

steps.text: Level a basic job pair such as Swordsman and Ronin, then buy the advanced job's unlock node in its job tree; those two unlock the Warrior.
Unlock all basic, advanced and expert jobs; the DLC jobs are not required.
Level the Black Mage, Berserker and Warrior job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the White Mage and Knight job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the Thief and Samurai job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the Thief and Monk job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the Dragoon and Warrior job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the Dragoon, Samurai and Berserker job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the Red Mage and Knight job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the Red Mage and Monk job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Level the Black Mage and White Mage job trees and buy the unlock node for this job.
Complete the final main mission; the Cyclic Warrior is granted with the ending.
Install the Season Pass and clear the base story; the Ancient Chaos Shrine then opens.
Complete the mission "Light of Possibility" on CHAOS difficulty, then complete "A Strange Presence" in the Dragon's Cave; clearing both unlocks BAHAMUT difficulty for the rest of the DLC.

achievements.summary: Complete the first Trials of the Dragon King mission.

steps.text: Keep completing Dragon King Trials to earn Dragon Treasures and advance conversations with Bahamut until "Cornelia's Hope" appears, then complete it.

achievements.description: Completed the additional mission: "Ebon Memories: Hope Within Despair."

steps.text: After Cornelia's Hope, pick up "Ebon Memories: Hope Within Despair" at Bahamut's lair and complete it.

achievements.description: Talked to Bahamut via Conversations with Bahamut.

steps.text: In the Bahamut menu, open Conversations with Bahamut and read one; this is available right after Light of Possibility.

achievements.summary: Talk to Bahamut via Conversations with Bahamut.

achievements.description: Completed a mission with a dragon king trial enabled.

steps.text: Enable any Dragon King Trial on a mission and complete it; Extra Mode makes the fight safe.

achievements.summary: Complete a mission with a Dragon King Trial enabled.

steps.text: Complete a mission on BAHAMUT difficulty; Rat Tails are part of the rewards.
Equip an accessory of rarity four stars or better; if none drops, trade Dragon Treasures at the Bahamut exchange shop for one.

achievements.summary: Equip a four-star or better accessory.

steps.text: Obtain and equip a staff.
Earn your first Rat Tail, then talk to Bahamut; he grants the class tree.
Spend roughly 60 Rat Tails filling every panel of one job's evocation or ultima tree.

achievements.summary: Unlock an entire evocation or ultima tree.

steps.text: Keep progressing Conversations with Bahamut until the Bahamut battle mission unlocks; win it and talk to Bahamut again.
Equip a staff to unlock Pilgrim, then advance the Pilgrim tree to unlock the Evoker.

achievements.description: Completed a floor of the rift labyrinth.

steps.text: Finish DLC1 to open the Rift Labyrinth, then enter it from the Rift hub.
Clear any single rift floor.

achievements.summary: Clear a floor of the Rift Labyrinth.

achievements.description: Completed over thirty rift labyrinth floors.

steps.text: Progress the Rift story to floor 21, where that story arc ends.
Extra Mode is disabled from floor 22, so gear up first: farm relics at the Stymied side mission with Dragon Trials on Lufenia, then push with a Marksman/Ninja setup.
Clear floor 30 to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: Clear more than thirty Rift Labyrinth floors.

steps.text: Progress a couple of Rift floors until the Astos-like NPC enables monster summoning, then use a Monster Bell to summon any monster.
From flawless summonstones, summon the Cactuar and the second Tonberry, then work their request chains.
Give Arcanium Crystals to the Cactuar until it hands over the Grudge Knife, then give Gil to the Tonberry until it asks for the knife; after another rift, talk to the Tonberry Blacksmith.

achievements.summary: Max out affinity with the Tonberry Blacksmith.

achievements.description: Maxed out your affinity with the discarded organic reconnaissance unit.

steps.text: After the death machine fight between floors 21 and 22, exhaust the Astos-like NPC's conversations in the hall.

achievements.summary: Max out affinity with the reconnaissance unit.

steps.text: From floor 22, wait for Gilgamesh to appear in the Hall of the Dark Crystal, clear the rift he opens, then talk to him again.
Obtain relics until you have 12 with 12 different summon blessings; relics come from the Rift and can also be traded at the exchange shop on the world map.

achievements.summary: Obtain relics with 12 different summon blessings.

achievements.displayName: The Laws of the Universe Are In Chaos!

steps.text: Unlock Dimension Bringer by progressing the Rift to floor 9, equip it in place of Lightbringer in Battle Settings, then use it in a normal (non-Extra Mode) mission.

achievements.description: Gave an elixir to a magic pot.

steps.text: After clearing rifts, watch the hall for a magic pot and give it an elixir; buy one from the Rift NPC if needed.

achievements.summary: Give an elixir to a magic pot.

steps.text: Keep clearing rifts until a chaos event appears; some rift types have a higher chance.
Defeat Gilgamesh a second time in the Rift (around floor 6) to receive Excalipoor and the Blue Mage job.
Around the end of the Rift story (floor 21) a side mission notification appears; complete "Chaos Rift - Battle on the Big Bridge" at Cornelia Bridge.

achievements.summary: Complete "Chaos Rift - Battle on the Big Bridge."

steps.text: Defeat the death machine boss when moving from floor 21 to 22.
Play Different Future until you obtain a gun, then equip it; the first gun also unlocks the Marksman job.

achievements.description: Unlocked every panel in the marksman job tree.

steps.text: Level the Marksman job and purchase every panel in its job tree.

achievements.summary: Unlock every panel in the Marksman job tree.

steps.text: Buy the Hunter unlock node at the bottom of the Marksman tree.
Buy the Gambler unlock node inside the Hunter tree.
Defeat any manikin in a LUFENIA mission.
Complete the first Different Future mission; Garland's armor is awarded automatically.

achievements.description: Used replication at the blacksmith for the first time.

steps.text: After the first DLC3 mission, open the Smith and use Replication on any equipment piece.

achievements.description: Completed the additional mission "Distant Memories: Supreme Illusions."

steps.text: After the fourth DLC3 story mission, pick up "Distant Memories: Supreme Illusions" at the Hall of the Dark Crystal and complete it.
Complete the DLC3 main missions; the Transcendent is one of the story bosses.
Complete the DLC3 main missions; From Hell Risen is one of the story bosses.

achievements.displayName: On the Way to a Brighter Future

steps.text: Complete the DLC3 main missions; the Light of Order is one of the story bosses.
Complete the final Different Future mission to beat Jack Garland and end the story.
